title: Bipsea
tagline: Bipsea is a digital (not NFT) marketplace. Sell digital. Earn crypto.
description:
With Bipsea, anyone can earn cryptocurrency. Simply upload a file, set a price, and get paid. That’s it.

We live in an information age. An age towards equal opportunity for billions of people. Individuals like us will have the same tools as multi-billion dollar corporations. Creative entrepreneurs will be rewarded for their work. Financial independence starts small. Start here. You’re at the right place.

Sell All Digital Forms:
✓ 3D models
✓Animations
✓ Apps
✓ e-Books
✓ Games
✓ PDFs
how_its_made:
This platform will not be possible without primitives such as cryptography, immutable storage, content identifiers, smart contracts, micro-transactions and other fancy words.

✓ Lit Protocol to encrypt files you want to sell.

✓ Filecoin as permanent storage

✓ IPFS as to address encrypted files

✓ Polygon to facilitate buying/selling

✓ Optimism to facilitate buying/selling

✓ The graph to index sales.
